note: bons remis à Google en contrepartie de son soutien aux obligations de Fluidstack (bail de Barber Lake) ; exerçables à compter du début du bail, jusqu'au 24 septembre 2030 ; juste valeur initiale de 544,5 M$ inscrite à l'actif comme valeur du soutien
quote: On September 24, 2025, as consideration for Google agreeing to backstop certain obligations of Fluidstack in connection with the Barber Lake Facility lease, the Company entered into the Google Warrant Agreement, pursuant to which the Company issued to Google warrants to purchase 24,178,576 shares (the "Warrant Shares") of the Company's Common Stock for an exercise price of $0.01 per share of Common Stock (the "Google Warrants").

note: garantie de valeur au profit de Google : Cipher complète en actions ou en numéraire si les actions sous-jacentes valent moins de 430,0 M$ au début de la période d'exercice
quote: Additionally, if, on the business day prior to the beginning of the exercise period under the Google Warrant Agreement, the value of the Warrant Shares does not equal or exceed $430.0 million, the Company shall be obligated to issue additional Warrant Shares and/or make a cash payment equal in the aggregate to such shortfall amount on the terms set forth in the Warrant Agreement.
trigger_description: if, on the business day prior to the beginning of the exercise period under the Google Warrant Agreement, the value of the Warrant Shares does not equal or exceed $430.0 million
